source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

procedure.command: bun run compile && bun run audit:electron-vault
procedure.launch: Electron 44.3.0 with --vault=<disposable> --open=Note.md, Xvfb display and a bounded fixed CDP-port range
procedure.workflow: The launch intent hydrated the visible Markdown editor; a CDP keyboard event triggered Ctrl/Cmd-S after Unicode input; source/live-preview mode controls were switched and the note was read back through the broker.
procedure.disposable_vault: A separate temporary vault contained Note.md and .obsidian/app.json; it was removed after the run.

result: The packaged Electron renderer now has a durable launch-intent and keyboard-save trace over the same revision-aware broker as the direct IPC round trip. Unicode text remained in the visible editor and persisted with an explicit save; mode switching did not alter source bytes.
limitations: This is disposable Linux x64 packaged-renderer evidence; macOS and Windows UI interaction, true OS IME, screen-reader, human focus, reference Obsidian and release validation remain pending.
CDP keyboard/input dispatch is renderer evidence, not OS IME or human accessibility certification.
The unchanged /home/ashutosh/Obsidian vault was not accessed or modified.
